description:
AUDIT 2026-10-27 (owner-adjudicated, advisor-reviewed): the acceptance and context sections supersede this description wherever they differ. Historical text below is kept for reference.

After dlv2-22 is accepted (2-3 green dispatches) and one scheduled nightly-v2 run has passed: delete nightly.yml (old), docker-integration.yml, cross-platform-validation.yml, cross-surface-baseline-autodetect.yml, pricing-data-drift-check.yml, submission-validator-drift-check.yml, corpus-drift-check.yml, and extension-smoke.yml if not already gone; rename nightly-v2.yml to nightly.yml.

Before nightly.yml is deleted, every job in it must have a home or a recorded drop reason. The known jobs without a nightly-v2 equivalent are the ruleset drift check (nightly.yml:885, see ruleset-drift-check-home-20261009), the throughput-uat jobs (nightly.yml:707 and :804, see nightly-v2-throughput-uat-port-20261009) and the rest listed in nightly-v2-unported-jobs-decision-20261009.

KEEP (do not delete): validate-submission.yml, validate-submission-comment.yml, sync-results-data-to-published.yml, corpus-event-bridge.yml, corpus-reconciler.yml, seed-corpus.yml, upload-answers.yml, todo-state-validate.yml, tpcds-official-qualification.yml, tpcds-platform-identity.yml, tpch-dbgen-intel-macos.yml, soundness-merge-digest.yml, oracle-verdict.yml, and all publication-*.yml (site-split-51 retires the publication-*.yml files, not this item).
